long_biography.plain_text:
Al Bilad (UK), the British arm of a Saudi investment group, placed Saïd Mohammed Ayas at the meeting point of Middle Eastern capital and British business. As a director, he worked within a platform created to sponsor commercial ventures and investment activity connected to Saudi Arabia. A separate London company, Fadace, was formed for property acquisition.

Ayas also served on the board of Luxembourg-registered Arab International Real Estate Development. That appointment added a real-estate company to his earlier British investment roles. The Luxembourg business was registered for international property development, and Ayas remained a director until shareholders chose not to renew his mandate in 1997.
